Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables -- part of the batch-1 scaling pass, prioritizing breadth of verified accessions over per-sample depth. Publication metadata pulled from PubMed esummary; not yet manually spot-checked against the full text for every record in this batch.
